issues.what: The bud swells out of the tip as a single rounded cap. Its individual points do not visibly separate until after the cap has formed.
issues.fix: Start with a closed bud already modeled at the tip, then let its overlapping bracts lift and separate at different rates as the stem elongates.

issues.where: broad leaves and nearby grass, f0594–f0599 (19.80–19.97 s)
issues.what: Rain streaks cross the leaf faces and foreground grass without discernible impacts, runoff, or small leaf responses where they meet.
issues.fix: Have droplets collide with the vegetation and ground, with occasional localized splashes, edge drips, and small deflections on separate leaves.

issues.where: backlit rim at the stem tip, f0750–f0754 (25.00–25.13 s)
issues.what: A short row of bright points snaps on along the tip rim, then dims within a few frames, making the fine edge shimmer at native size.
issues.fix: Keep the hairs attached to the same surface positions through the growth and stabilize their highlights with temporal sampling.
